testCase.name: List Index Out of Bounds
testCase.errorText:
IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 5 out of bounds for length 3
    at com.example.ListAdapter.getItem(ListAdapter.kt:42)

results.rootCause: The error occurred because the code is trying to access an index in a string that has fewer characters than expected. Specifically, when splitting the string at index 5, which suggests the original string was supposed to have more than 5 characters. This might be due to incorrect assumptions about the length of the string being split.
fixGuidelines: Step 1: Edit ListAdapter.kt line 42

Before:
```kotlin
str = "abcd"
index = 5
result = str.split(index)
```
After:
```kotlin
str = "abcdef"
index = 3
result = if (index >= str.size) {
    return empty list
} else {
    return the substring up to index
}
Run ./gradle build to verify the fix is applied correctly.
Prevent recurrence by ensuring that any string operations account for variable lengths and use safe bounds checking.
